name: CreateParameterGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the parameter template is located.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
参数模板所在地域的地域ID。

您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the database engine. Only MySQL is supported
parameters.help_zh: 数据库引擎类型，当前仅支持MySQL
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
The version of the database engine. Valid values:

5.6

5.7

8.0
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎版本号，取值范围如下：

5.6

5.7

8.0
parameters.name: db_version

parameters.help_en:
The name of the parameter template. The name must meet the following requirements:

It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (). It cannot contain Chinese characters or end with an underscore ().

It must be 8 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
参数模板的名称，需满足如下要求：

由英文、数字、和下划线（）组成，以字母开头，不能包含中文，不能以下划线（）结尾。

长度为8~64个字符
parameters.name: parameter_group_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the parameter template. It must be 0 to 199 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 参数模板的描述，长度为0~199个字符
parameters.name: parameter_group_desc

parameters.help_en:
A JSON string that consists of parameters and their values. The values of the parameters must be strings. For example: `{"wait_timeout":"86400","innodb_old_blocks_time":"1000"}`.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207428.html operation to view the details of all parameters for a specific database engine version. The details include parameter names and value ranges
parameters.help_zh:
参数及其值的JSON串，参数的值都是字符串类型，例如`{"wait_timeout":"86400","innodb_old_blocks_time":"1000"}`。

您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207428.html查看目标数据库引擎版本数据库集群的所有参数详情，包括参数名称、取值范围等
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

ParameterGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the parameter template.

You can call the [DescribeParameterGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207178.html） operation to query the list of parameter templates in a region, including their IDs
ParameterGroupId.description_zh:
参数模板ID。

您可以通过[DescribeParameterGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207178.html）接口查看目标地域的参数模板列表，包括参数模板ID
